Mmm... ahhh...I had a good sleep.
W-w-who, who, who are you?
Me? I'm nobody important. I'm Flammel, the god\nof fire.
Really?! Another one? You're one of the 12 gods in\nour world?!
Oh, gods don't exist in the world of the Ranas.\nGods are humans who created our world...No, not\nhumans, but they aren't things either, hmm...
Entities, yeah! They're entities!\nAnyway, why are you here?
This is embarrassing. Actually right after putting\nthe world back together during the cataclysm,\nI was attacked by someone and I crash landed here
in Aqua Gota. To repay the Ranas who saved me,\nI built the Little Shrine of Grace in Aquacity,\nwhich was under construction at the time.
I decided to stay inside the shrine to supply heat\nand light for the entire city until the lives of\nthe Ranas become stable.
But it seems that I accidentally fell asleep and\nended up staying inside the shrine for a long\ntime...
Anyway, there should have been a powerful flame\nburst when the door opened. How did you dodge it?
Of course we dodged it with all our might.\nOtherwise, we would have turned into barbecue!\nYou should tone it down a bit!!
Hahaha, nice dodge, excellent! That was the power\naccumulated in the shrine that turned into flames\nand got discharged all at once. You were lucky!
Jeez, you're kinda sloppy for a god.\nUnlike Vasaria...
What? Vasaria?! You've met her before?
Yes, in the moving forest...
Oh, my...I didn't know she came to this world\ntoo...
By the way...
I woke up to the feeling of unusual beings\napproaching in large numbers...
Whaaat?!
There are a myriad of amorphous monsters moving in\nthe sea.
Coenubias!!
They seem to be heading to a town not too far from\nhere.
Maybe Marinatown.\nThere are quite many Ranas there.\nWe need to save them! Let's go now!
Can we ask you to help, too?
We have to help since we already know too much!\nOh, the god of fire will help too, right?
No, I'll head up to the town from here. It's not\nas bad as what I feel from the nearby town, but\nI can slightly feel a disturbing presence there.
What disturbing presence? Well, okay. Let's leave\nthat to the god. We'll go to, it's called\nMarinatown, right? Okay, let's go there!!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore this place a little longer!
